subject: Post-discovery: pilot onramp, stakeholder intake & demo windows
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Dana Morales <dana.morales@stepstone.io>, Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@stepstone.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: pilot onramp, stakeholder intake & demo windows

Hi Dana / Amit —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: StepStone wants a 2-week pilot to validate batch inference throughput for job description embeddings, SSO integration via SAML, and an evaluation of audit logs/retention.
- Key stakeholders to include on the pilot/demo: Security (ops), Procurement, and Platform/Dev leads.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive + short sandbox demo (45–60 min) — objective: confirm SSO flow, KV cache behavior with your sample workload, and baseline token costs.
2) Procurement sync — quick 20–30 min to cover PO path and contract timing.
3) Evidence packet — we'll send SOC2 snippets, retention controls, and an SSO checklist.

Possible windows this week / next (all PST):
- Tue 17 Mar: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 18 Mar: 09:30–10:30 or 13:00–14:00
- Thu 19 Mar: 11:00–12:00

If you can, please add the procurement and security contacts who should join the relevant sessions. I pulled together a short discovery notes PDF and our SSO checklist — attaching those now.

Next: if you confirm attendees and a preferred window, I’ll send calendar invites and loop in Marissa (solutions lead) and Sean (platform/ops lead) to present the technical demo. Also happy to run a shorter internal alignment call for procurement only if that helps the buying path.

Thanks — excited to get a pilot stood up quickly.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachments: discovery-notes-stepstone-20260315.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); sso-checklist-stepstone.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Dana Morales <dana.morales@stepstone.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@stepstone.io>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@stepstone.io>, procurement <procurement@stepstone.io>, security-ops <sec_ops@stepstone.io>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: pilot onramp, stakeholder intake & demo windows

Lauren —

Thanks for the clear recap. Both Amit and I found the call useful. Quick answers from our side:

- Confirm pilot scope: yes to embeddings throughput + SSO + logs.
- Procurement lead: Nina Patel (copied).
- Security ops: sec_ops@stepstone.io (copied).

Availability for the technical session: Wed 18 Mar 13:00–14:00 PST works best for our platform and security folks. Procurement (Nina) prefers Thu 19 Mar 11:00–11:30 PST for a procurement-only sync.

A couple of asks before the demo:
- Can you share a short Playbook/MoP for the pilot (what we should provision on our side, sample data needs, and rollback plan)?
- We need an NDA before exchanging any example data — do you have a standard one or should we send ours?

If it's easier, we can route the NDA through DocuSign.

Thanks — Dana
Dana Morales
Head of Product, StepStone
dana.morales@stepstone.io | +1 (212) 555-9876

Dana / team —

Great — thanks for confirming. I’ve penciled in:
- Technical deep-dive + sandbox demo: Wed 18 Mar, 13:00–14:00 PST (calendar invite to follow).
- Procurement-only sync: Thu 19 Mar, 11:00–11:30 PST.

Marissa (Solutions Engineer) and Sean (Platform) — looping you in to lead the technical session. Marissa -> will you cover the sandbox walkthrough and KV/cache behavior? Sean -> can you bring a short note on expected token economics for StepStone’s batch profile?

On the asks from Dana:
- Pilot MoP / Playbook: attaching a draft pilot-mop-v0.3.docx (high level: environment checklist, data samples, success criteria, rollback).
- NDA: we can send our standard mutual NDA via DocuSign. If you prefer, Nina feel free to share StepStone’s template and we’ll review.

Attachments: pilot-mop-v0.3.docx (DOCX)

Thanks — I’ll send invites and a Drive folder with the evidence packet + SOC2 excerpt prior to the demo.

—Lauren

Hi all — thanks for looping me in. Procurement side: we’ll need standard commercial terms and a ballpark estimate for pilot spend to route for PO approval. Quick notes:

- Estimate: please provide expected spend range for a 2-week pilot (approx. vCPU/GPU hours or per-token estimate) so we can budget.
- Contract: we’ll need Redwood’s standard SOW + mutual NDA. DocuSign route is fine.
- Timeline: if demo goes well Wed afternoon, procurement aims to have PO approved within 10 business days.

Lauren — Marissa/Sean, please include a one-slide cost summary in the follow-up so Nina can route internally. Also please upload the SOC2 excerpt and retention controls to the Drive folder Lauren referenced before the demo.

Thanks — Nina
Nina Patel
Head of Procurement, StepStone
Nina.Patel@stepstone.io | +1 (415) 555-3344
